valuationIntro: Need an independent valuation report for a property in Turkey? IGA Law Firm can help coordinate the process with an appropriately qualified independent valuation provider. Please share your property location and contact details so our team can discuss the next steps.
scope: Legal due diligence, independent valuation and citizenship eligibility review are distinct services. A valuation alone does not establish citizenship eligibility; official conformity and citizenship decisions belong to the competent authorities. No valuation amount, fee or delivery time is guaranteed.
documents: Please do not submit identity numbers, passports, title deeds, bank documents or sensitive personal information. If documents are needed, our team will arrange a secure follow-up channel.
privacy: IGA Law Firm receives the contact details, property information and message you provide through this form to assess your request, contact you and discuss possible legal services. Authorized team members and our existing website and email service providers process the inquiry for these purposes. This form does not subscribe you to marketing. For questions about your personal data or to exercise your applicable access, correction or deletion rights, contact info@igalawfirm.com.
